summary: Tested Member Lookup (Money > Subscriptions/Payments e-mail link, side panel, Open full profile -> /admin/users?open=), Pro welcome e-mail end to end (real Stripe sandbox checkout with 4242 card, trial), webhook replay idempotency, templates (16, pro_welcome preview), campaign refusal, and regression of Pricing/checkout/Account billing/Coupons/Revenue/Plans/Campaigns. Backend 12/12 pass. Desktop UI all pass. One HIGH bug on phones (<wide breakpoint): the member e-mail link, 'Cancel at period end', 'Refund' (and any other in-row button) are dead because ResponsiveTable wraps the card in a DISABLED <button>.

minor.issue: Welcome only fires when the FIRST subscription event (was_new) has status active/trialing. If a subscription starts 'incomplete' (3-D Secure / SCA card) and later becomes active via customer.subscription.updated, was_new is False and no pro_welcome is ever sent. Consider sending on the first transition into active/trialing (idem key already prevents duplicates).

Raw e-mails are attached for any role with billing.read, including 'analyst' which lacks users.pii; /api/admin/users/{id} masks e-mail for the same role. Mask in _with_emails when actor lacks users.pii.

The marketing_enabled check runs before the managed-provider check, so with marketing off the admin first sees 'Turn on e-mail and marketing e-mail', turns it on, then gets refused for a different reason. Check the provider first. (Managed refusal itself verified by a unit call: correct ValueError text, 0 e-mails logged.)
Preview has no sample 'trial' value and uses date '2026-12-01' while real sends use '01 November 2026' format; preview never shows the trial sentence.

ui_bugs.component: admin/parts.jsx ResponsiveTable (phone card view) used by Subscriptions, Payments, Coupons, Campaigns
ui_bugs.issue: When onRow is not passed the card is rendered as <button disabled>. Clicks on nested buttons inside a disabled button are swallowed, so at 390px the member e-mail link (member-open-*), sub-cancel-*, sub-resume-*, pay-refund-*, coupon-off-*, camp-send-* do nothing. Verified: outer .a-rowcard disabled=true, clicking link/cancel opens neither member-panel nor sub-confirm. Also React warns validateDOMNesting <button> inside <button>. Fix: render a <div> (not a button) when !onRow, or avoid nesting buttons.

issues: Canceled rows show an empty pill/chip for the blank actions column (the '' label column renders an empty .a-kv).

action_items: Fix ResponsiveTable phone cards: do not render a disabled <button> wrapper when onRow is absent (use div/li), so in-row links and action buttons work on mobile; re-check Subscriptions, Payments, Coupons, Campaigns at 390px.
Send pro_welcome on the first move into active/trialing (not only on was_new) to cover subscriptions that start 'incomplete'.
Mask e-mails in _with_emails for roles without users.pii.
Optional: order send_campaign checks so the managed-provider refusal shows first; add sample trial text to the pro_welcome preview and align date format.
Optional: hide empty action-column chip on phone cards.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.jsx: open state is initialised from ?open only once (useState(sp.get('open'))); navigating to /admin/users?open=<other> while already on Users will not open the new drawer. Derive from searchParams or sync with useEffect.
Who component: a soft-deleted user (deleted_at set but user_id kept) would show a link to 'deleted+<id>@invalid' and the panel 404s; delete_account nulls user_id so this is only a theoretical path.

Verified good: idem key pro_welcome-<uid>-<sub> plus webhook_events dedupe -> replay of the same event id returns 'duplicate', a new event id for the same subscription is processed but sends no second e-mail.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (desktop flows all pass; mobile in-row actions broken)

rca of the issue: Mobile dead buttons: parts.jsx ResponsiveTable line ~89 renders <button className='a-rowcard' disabled={!onRow}> around the card content. Money/Email tables never pass onRow, so the wrapper is disabled; browsers do not dispatch click events to descendants of a disabled button, so stopPropagation-based inner buttons never fire. Repro: 390x844, /admin/subscriptions, tap the e-mail link or 'Cancel at period end' -> nothing. Mitigation: use a non-interactive element when onRow is absent.
